description: Proportional-symbol map of dogs recorded at home in South Australian councils, 2025. One circle represents one council; circle area is proportional to its dog total. Hover for exact council values.

data.description: One record per council. Draw the largest circles first so smaller circles remain visible above them.

scales.name: symbolArea
scales.description: Map dog totals linearly to symbol area, not radius. Twice the total produces twice the area.

marks.name: councilSymbols
marks.description: One circle at each council geographic centroid. Circle area shows the raw dog total; the centre represents the council, not an animal address.

tooltip.signal: {'Council': datum.name, 'Dogs recorded at home': format(datum.animals, ',.0f'), 'Residents': format(datum.residents, ',.0f'), 'Dogs per 1,000 residents': format(datum.rate, '.1f')}

description.signal: datum.name + ': ' + format(datum.animals, ',.0f') + ' dogs recorded at home.'

usermeta.method: One circle per council, placed at its projected geographic centroid. A zero-based linear scale maps recorded-at-home dog totals to circle area. Largest circles draw first; transparency and outlines reveal overlap. The map shows the settled south; all 68 councils remain in the underlying dataset.
usermeta.codeGuide: Data lookup joins totals to council boundaries. geoCentroid places symbols. symbolArea maps totals to area. The councilSymbols tooltip expression supplies hover values; hover changes outline and opacity without changing size.
